description: This file defines the AuthenticatorManager class, which manages authenticator-related operations such as listing, deleting, generating registration/authentication options, and verifying registration responses. It interacts with external services and preferences to handle authenticators within an application.

classes.name: AuthenticatorManager
classes.description: A class that manages authenticator operations such as listing, deleting, registration, and authentication, extending AbstractService and implementing AuthenticatorClientInterface.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of authenticators, decorated with names from preferences or defaulting to 'Security Key'.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an authenticator by ID and updates preferences accordingly.

methods.name: generateRegistrationOptions
methods.description: Generates registration options for authenticators via API.

methods.name: verifyRegistrationResponse
methods.description: Verifies a registration response and updates preferences with the new authenticator name.

methods.name: generateAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Generates authentication options for a given username via API.

methods.name: getAuthenticatorNamesFromPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves a map of authenticator IDs to names from stored preferences.
